visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces with subtle warm tints. Avoid heavy glassmorphism for this earthy vibe.

layouts.app_shell: Responsive sidebar layout (sidebar hidden on mobile behind hamburger) with a top navigation bar. Sidebar should have generous vertical padding.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Use a bento-style or dense grid for 'My Habits' and 'Community'. E.g., grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-6.
layouts.habit_page: Max-w-3xl centralized layout. Generous padding (p-8 or p-12). Clear visual separation between the habit details, the 7-day checkboxes, stats, and the comments section.
layouts.spacing: Use generous Tailwind spacing (p-6, p-8, gap-8) to give the application a breathable, calming feel.

components.cards: Cardless or very subtle cards with white background, 1px border, and soft shadow.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), solid for primary actions (Add Habit, Post Comment), outline/ghost for secondary.
components.checkboxes: Shadcn Checkbox. For the 7-day tracker, use a row of large, tap-friendly checkboxes labeled with dates (e.g. 'Mon 12').
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Textarea. Inputs should have generous height (h-12) and rounded-xl.

auth_background.description: Warm sand texture for the auth page split-screen background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize simplicity and usability over complex animations.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Ensure these fonts are imported in your CSS or index.html.
In the Sidebar, highlight the active page clearly with the primary color.
For the 7-day tracker on the Habit page, align the 7 checkboxes horizontally (or wrapped on mobile) with clear date labels (YYYY-MM-DD or readable equivalent).
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (e.g., Check, Plus, MessageCircle, LogOut).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the top header. Use a solid background like #FDFBF7 with a bottom border.
Ensure hover states have higher contrast and clear visual feedback.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g. data-testid='sign-in-button', data-testid='habit-card').
Do not add any features not requested in the original problem statement (e.g., no password reset, no complex profiles).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
